acquisition_method.evidence: The MS/MS-based proteomics data were acquired on an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer operated in DDA mode.
experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

cleavage_agent.evidence: The sample was digested overnight in 2 μl trypsin (200 ng/μl) at 37°C.

collision_energy.evidence: The MS2 scan was set to 0.7 m/z isolation window, 36% HCD collision energies, 45 000 resolution, auto mode of maximum injection time and 200% AGC target.

fragmentation_method.evidence: The MS2 scan was set to 0.7 m/z isolation window, 36% HCD collision energies, 45 000 resolution, auto mode of maximum injection time and 200% AGC target.

mass_analyzer.evidence: The MS/MS-based proteomics data were acquired on an Orbitrap Exploris 480 mass spectrometer operated in DDA mode.

reduction_reagent.evidence: Half of the elution sample was combined with 10 mM DTT and 5% SDS, then incubated at 95°C for 10 min to reduce and denature proteins.
